profile.headline: Software Engineer en Tesla
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7 plus years of experience in software development (web-based applications, scripting and distributed systems) considering the Software Development Life Cycle process.
For web development, experience as a full-stack developer with Python 3 and frameworks such as Django and Django ORM/ Flask; with JavaScript and frameworks such as Next.js, React and Tailwind, jQuery and Bootstrap.
Experience as a front-end developer building function-based components with React.js for Single Page Applications (SPA), styling with CSS or Tailwind, building web apps that are heavily text-based like newspaper's web apps or blogs using Server Side Rendering (SSR) with Next.js.
Experience with NPM as the main package manager for web applications that follow MERN stack. Experience creating projects from scratch, install/uninstall packages, manage YARN or package.json files.
Experience with cloud services to deploy and manage applications such as AWS (EC2 for running containerized applications and servers, S3 for storing file media such as images and videos). In addition to AWS, I have experience with Heroku and Linode. 
Experience as a consultant software engineer for short and long-term projects considering modern tech stacks (MERN).
Experience as a consultant software engineer for short and long-term projects considering Django, MongoDB and AWS for event-driven web applications.
Experience with Test Driven Development methodology performing manual and automated/ unit, integration and acceptance testing. 
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB considering the Data Model Design for a given system.
Experience working and designing systems like MVC, Multi-Tier architectures, Client-Server architecture.
Experience with XML, JSON, Web Services, publishing and consuming them.
Experience working in projects related to Data Science and Machine learning with Python and frameworks such as NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pandas.
Experience with Panda for data wrangling including creating data frames; cleaning and combining data sets; basic plotting and reading from different files such as CSV to generate data frames.
For the last 5 years I have been responsible for developing web-based applications and services available through APIs using modern standards such as JWT, cloud computing and data distribution.
Very strong analytical skills, self-motivated worker and enthusiast of new technologies, very detail-oriented and well organized. Focus on security, high quality product delivery, and client satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role focused on back-end development for short and long-term projects:
Back-end development with Python (main framework Flask) and Golang to create REST API endpoints for Big Data, real-time analysis and management projects
Manage metrics and data from factories from SQL Server, MongoDB and Vertica. Create pipelines to get data from 3rd party API’s, transform/clean data.
Monitor performance through Sentry and Splunk.
positions.insights: Skills: Diseño de código · Go · Splunk · SQL · Depuración de programas · Flask · Python · Análisis de datos · MongoDB

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack web development with Python, Django; JavaScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind. Consultant role focused on End-to-end software development for short and long-term projects.
Focused on full stack development for short and long-term projects considering SDLC.
Responsible for the architectural design and development of a web application that tracks the scores from players during events for MLB junior leagues, show information to operators about positions, details of events and search for MLB Officials. This was created with JavaScript, React, Tailwind, Nodejs and MongoDB (MERN stack, multi-tier architecture).
Medical projects. Back-end development with Python and Django to manage data from specific devices. Monitor and configure metrics to create patient records. Development focused on REST API calls, unit testing and DevOps strategy.
Social media projects. Full-stack development with JavaScript, Next.js and React to create a custom Blog that requires specific layouts to show information based on date, similarity and reading time. Integration with Contentful API/ GreenHouse to get data and generate articles/ job posts, tailwind configuration for styling layouts, Next.js to implement server-side rendering, third-party libraries to perform social sharing features.
Involved in the gathering of requirements and design of the solution.
Design and create database schemas.
Implement a database replication strategy for development servers.
Design, develop and deploy web applications by integrating modern technologies and agile methodologies for CI/CD.
Environment: JavaScript, React, MongoDB, Python, Jira, AWS EC2, Heroku, Git, GitLab.
positions.insights: Skills: Diseño de código · Depuración de programas

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) implementations, integrations, and customizations.  No two projects are the same, so it's important to develop the ability to learn quickly, be a problem solver and help design, develop, and test software solutions for a diverse set of clients in industries such as Life Sciences, Retail, and Industrial High Tech.
Developed an API that was used to gather information from different sources (sensors in a factory). The operators also deliver a package that could be uploaded as an image with different documents through their devices. 
Maintain and add new functions to the web-based application, this was developed using React, JavaScript.
PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) implementations, integrations, and customizations. Front-end and back-end development with Python, JavaScript, React, ThingWorx, Java for IoT applications.
Test REST services provided for the operators in order to provide assessment.
Monitoring data through Dashboards created based on their needs. 
Design of custom strategic dashboards; integration with IoT devices to manage alarms, input/output data; cloud computing (Microsoft Azure) for managing specific services (Azure Event Hub, Azure Blob Storage)
Work with a team of 7 developers following Agile methodologies. Weekly calls with stakeholders to review progress, address issues and evaluate how to solve them.
Review jobs, source code when we merge changes to production.
Provide suggestions of performance improvements on queries and scheduled jobs.
Provide a strategy to connect devices with ThingWorx and Azure considering number of devices, servers, API calls.
Review and  the projects approved by the PMO.
Provide assessment and guidance in project development.
Manage and coordinate the corresponding teams.
Environment: Python, JavaScript, React, ThingWorx, Java, Jira, Azure, Git.
positions.insights: Skills: Diseño de código · Depuración de programas

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer focused on performing basic to intermediate system configuration and customization; development of software extensions and integrations using specific API’s; Data Migration (Data Analysis, Manipulation and Migration using an ETL process); quality of code by performing unit testing and code reviews; technical and functional specifications based on software design and performance; status reporting within their teams and with the clients.
PMS development for hotels in Mexico considering services and connections to OTA’s to perform online reservations and data mining for occupancy rate. 
Analyze the company’s requirements, present proposals for development. According to the proposals made, coordinate the development team to achieve goals
Developed the web pages for the different modules and system’s areas.
Analyze the process and  provide solutions to the reported issues.
Analyzed existing web pages and  provided suggestions and recommendations to improve the code and performance. Also compare with current platforms that perform similar tasks.
Infrastructure design; back-end development using Django, PostgreSQL and NGINX; front-end development using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and frameworks such as jQuery, Bootstrap and React     
Manipulated the table’s structure, in order to  design and create objects with their relationships in the database.
Analyze existing web services to  apply improvements or resolve issues or related requirements.
Coordinated with customers to gather additional requirements.
Developed new or update the existing web services to help the communication between intern systems, OTAs and Salesforce
Design of a simple data warehouse for collecting information from OTA’s in AWS     
Environment: Django, PostgreSQL and NGINX, Web Services, Javascript, jQuery, CSS, Linode, AWS.

positions.title: Desarrollador web
positions.locationName: Puebla de Zaragoza y alrededores, México
positions.description:
Web app developer for Volkswagen Puebla, Mexico focused on performing basic to intermediate system configuration and customization, development of software extensions and integrations using specific API’s, ensuring quality of code by performing unit testing, code reviews and version control, assisting in the data model and the mapping definition.
Analyze the API’s code migrated from Volkswagen Group to Azure and provided feedback about the findings and how to resolve the issues if any.
Create components to validate new features to implement in the app.
Analyze the current company’s infrastructure to provide an assessment on how to implement a Cache Initiative focused on improving the performance of the applications.
Developed a web application, the application tested the APIs that we were migrating from COEX to Azure, it was created for the architecture team to test current APIs and provide statistics about errors, delays and successful executions.
Back-end development focused on REST services for attending COEX and SOEX using Java, Spring; front-end development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks such as jQuery and Bootstrap; concepts about user experience and usability based on the 10 heuristic rules of Jakob Nielsen for web applications.
When a bug was detected a bug was opened on Jira and assigned to me.
The PM assigned the tasks or user stories on Jira.
PMBoK and SEBoK were the guidelines for project management and production of quality code, respectively.     
Environment: Azure API Management, Postman, Bitbucket, Java, Spring, JavaScript

positions.title: Desarrollador web
positions.description:
Develop and maintain a dashboard for the customers to review statistics of the information they were feeding to their systems with tools made by UDLAP. This app had different modules for each interface the customer was using, so the approach for this application was a Single Page Application (SPA) in order to split the frontend and backend for the different teams, as this was a heavily used application we tried to reduce the maintenance windows. 
This application was developed with HTML5 and CSS, so we also updated the frontend with more modern tools such as React.js.
Design and developed tools and new functionalities.
Implemented data integration using specialized automation tools for generating reports and sending emails to notify changes or new information.
Design and development of the objects used as staging tables on the migration of the information from XML files generated by Excel to CA Clarity PPM via XOG.
Parse and transform XML files to be stored in the staging tables for further analysis and use.
Meetings with the team to discuss activities for each team member.
Coach and Managed a team of three developers; requirements gathering; design (mockups/sketches) of new screens and functionality. 
Created documentation for business and QA teams based on requirements.
Manage a team of three specialists based in Monterrey to support and develop in house applications
Environment: JavaScript, Python, C#, SQL Server 2012, jQuery, React.js, Express.js, AWS EC2
